1: // Canvas Catch game
2: // Canvas element with id "game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5: if (!canvas) {
6:   throw new Error('Canvas element with id "game" not found');
7: }
8: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
9: 
10: // Audio setup
11: const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
12: function playBeep(frequency, duration) {
13:   const oscillator = audioCtx.createOscillator();
14:   const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
15:   oscillator.type = 'sine';
16:   oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(frequency, audioCtx.currentTime);
17:   gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
18:   oscillator.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
19:   oscillator.start();
20:   oscillator.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
21: }
22: function playCatchSound() { playBeep(400, 0.1); }
23: function playGameOverSound() { playBeep(150, 0.3); }
24: function startBackgroundMusic() {
25:   // simple repeating low‑frequency hum
26:   const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
27:   const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
28:   osc.type = 'sine';
29:   osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(60, audioCtx.currentTime);
30:   gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.02, audioCtx.currentTime);
31:   osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
32:   osc.start();
33:   // keep reference to stop later if needed
34:   window._bgOsc = osc;
35: }
36: // start music on first user interaction
37: window.addEventListener('click', function initAudio(){
38:   if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
39:   startBackgroundMusic();
40:   window.removeEventListener('click', initAudio);
41: });
42: 
43: 
44: // Resize canvas to fill its container
45: function resize() {
46:   const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
47:   canvas.width = rect.width;
48:   canvas.height = rect.height;
49: }
50: window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
51: resize();
52: 
53: // Game state
54: let player = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height - 30, radius: 15, speed: 5 };
55: let stars = [];
56: let score = 0;
57: let highScore = Number(localStorage.getItem('highScore')) || 0;
58: let gameOver = false;
59: 
60: // Input handling (arrow keys / WASD)
61: const keys = {};
62: window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
63: window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
64: 
65: function spawnStar() {
66:   const radius = 8 + Math.random() * 8;
67:   const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - radius * 2) + radius;
68:   const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 2;
69:   stars.push({ x, y: -radius, radius, speed });
70: }
71: setInterval(spawnStar, 1000);
72: 
73: function update() {
74:   if (gameOver) return;
75:   if (keys.ArrowLeft || keys.a) player.x -= player.speed;
76:   if (keys.ArrowRight || keys.d) player.x += player.speed;
77:   player.x = Math.max(player.radius, Math.min(canvas.width - player.radius, player.x));
78:   for (let i = stars.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
79:     const s = stars[i];
80:     s.y += s.speed;
81:     const dx = s.x - player.x;
82:     const dy = s.y - player.y;
83:     const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
84:     if (dist < s.radius + player.radius) {
85:       score++;
86:       stars.splice(i, 1);
87:       playCatchSound();
88:       continue;
89:     }
90:     if (s.y - s.radius > canvas.height) {
91:       gameOver = true;
92:       playGameOverSound();
93:       if (score > highScore) {
94:         highScore = score;
95:         localStorage.setItem('highScore', highScore);
96:       }
97:       break;
98:     }
99:   }
100: }
101: 
102: function draw() {
103:   // background gradient
104:   const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
105:   bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
106:   bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#004');
107:   ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
108:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
109: 
110:   // twinkling background stars
111:   ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
112:   for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
113:     const sx = Math.random() * canvas.width;
114:     const sy = Math.random() * canvas.height;
115:     const r = Math.random() * 1.5;
116:     ctx.beginPath();
117:     ctx.arc(sx, sy, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
118:     ctx.fill();
119:   }
120: 
121:   // player with radial gradient
122:   const pGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
123:     player.x, player.y, player.radius * 0.2,
124:     player.x, player.y, player.radius
125:   );
126:   pGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0f0');
127:   pGrad.addColorStop(1, '#060');
128:   ctx.fillStyle = pGrad;
129:   ctx.beginPath();
130:   ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, player.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
131:   ctx.fill();
132: 
133:   // stars with glow
134:   stars.forEach(s => {
135:     const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(s.x, s.y, 0, s.x, s.y, s.radius);
136:     grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,0,0.9)');
137:     grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,0,0)');
138:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
139:     ctx.beginPath();
140:     ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
141:     ctx.fill();
142:   });
143: 
144:   // UI text
145:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
146:   ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
147:   ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
148:   ctx.fillText(`High: ${highScore}`, 10, 40);
149: 
150:   if (gameOver) {
151:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
152:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
153:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f55';
154:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
155:     ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
156:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
157:   }
158: }
159: 
160: function loop() {
161:   update();
162:   draw();
163:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
164: }
165: requestAnimationFrame(loop);
166: }
